label: failed

deny_reasons.cpu_avg: Only known after the instance finishes; post-hoc telemetry.
deny_reasons.cpu_max: Only known after the instance finishes; post-hoc telemetry.
deny_reasons.mem_avg: Only known after the instance finishes; post-hoc telemetry.
deny_reasons.mem_max: Only known after the instance finishes; post-hoc telemetry.
deny_reasons.end_time: Outcome time; using it is label leakage.
deny_reasons.status: The label is derived from this column.
deny_reasons.outcome: This is a recoding of the target.
deny_reasons.waste_window_upper_bound_seconds: Upper bound from parent-task end; not a feature.
deny_reasons.waste_window_imputed: Flags an imputed waste window; derived from missing end_time.
deny_reasons.task_end_time: Parent-task outcome time; using it is leakage.
deny_reasons.task_start_time: Parent-task start; not an instance-level causal feature.
deny_reasons.terminal_type: Google terminal event name; recoding of the label.
deny_reasons.terminal_code: Google integer event code; recoding of the label.
deny_reasons.start_imputed: Flags a missing SCHEDULE; derived from the event stream, not a causal feature.
deny_reasons.sched_time: Schedule timestamp of this attempt; used to build the row, not a feature.
deny_reasons.submit_time: Submit timestamp; fallback start, not an instance-level causal feature.
deny_reasons.seconds_to_next_failure: Deterministic function of the (legacy) machine-minute label.
deny_reasons.failure_within_horizon: Legacy machine-minute target; not the prediction unit.
deny_reasons.instance_name: Instance identity; not a causal feature and can encode duplicates.
deny_reasons.job_name: Job identity leaks across sibling instances of the same failing job.
deny_reasons.task_name: Task identity leaks across sibling instances of the same failing task.

notes: Join machine-grid features only on (machine_id, time_stamp <= decision_time). Never use future grid rows. machine_id is allowed for within-provider models (Alibaba time-grid join) but is not a valid cross-provider feature: identifier spaces are disjoint and coercing the Alibaba string id to numeric yields all-NaN. Cross-provider comparison must use plan_cpu_frac / plan_mem_frac, not raw plan_cpu / plan_mem: Alibaba plan_cpu is hundredths of a core on a 96-thread machine, Google cpus_request is already a fraction of the largest machine in the cell. attempt_index (Google) is the homolog of seq_no (Alibaba); both are exposed as retry_index at eval time. Memory fractions have no shared physical divisor — treat plan_mem_frac as a within-provider relative size, not a portable quantity.
